title: Enterprise Support: Tax treatment and signed totals
content:
Enterprise Support — Tax treatment and signed totals.

## Policy clauses

The applicable tax classification has an approved system review.

Use the source contract tax treatment reviewed at the service date and tax rates.

Apply tax to the final rounded net service amount; round tax separately using monetary decimal precision and rounding convention.

For a correction or credit use the original charge tax basis unless an approved tax-error review supplies the corrected treatment.

Tax credits have negative signed tax amount; charges and upward adjustments have positive signed tax amount.

Unsupported tax jurisdictions are outside the covered policy, not assumed exempt.

Sum net subtotal and signed tax to obtain the financial amount.

A verified exemption overrides the ordinary taxable rate; there is no stacking of tax treatments.

## Authoritative evidence

The applicable tax classification has an approved system review. The authoritative system record must establish the condition before the action. Its evidence comprises support contract reference, tax review status, tax treatment. Correlate the action to the same support contract reference.

## Hypothetical case

For a hypothetical final rounded net amount of USD 20 and an applicable tax rate of 10 percent, tax is USD 2 and the financial amount is USD 22. For a proportionate full credit on the same basis, the tax component has negative sign.
